scripts.dev: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test:unit
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test:unit && bun run build
scripts.test:capabilities: bun run build && node packages/test/dist/cli.js test test-sdk-capabilities --project=cursor
scripts.test:tour: bun run build && node packages/test/dist/cli.js test tour --project=openai
scripts.test:matrix: bun run build && node packages/test/dist/cli.js test test-sdk-capabilities
scripts.test:sdk:hosts: bun run build && node packages/test/dist/cli.js test tour --grep "answers from the project guide"
scripts.test:reliability: bun run build && node packages/test/dist/cli.js test test-sdk-capabilities --project=cursor --repeat-each=20 --retries=0
scripts.test:sdk:contracts: bun run build && node node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js test -c packages/test/fixtures/sdk-v2/agent-test.config.ts

simple-git-hooks.pre-commit: bun run lint && bun run typecheck
